purpose: one passive rover_only validation session; no movement

environment.lifecycle_id: the unique owner_id returned by this one protected START; bind every subsequent artifact to it

precondition: fresh protected precheck SATISFIED immediately before START; lifecycle rechecks under locks; no START if blocked or unconfirmed
allowed_operations: one protected headless START for rover_only
one new MotionBinding /2 collection: discovery 15s, sample 60s, 5 samples

read-only parameter acquisition: timeout 3s, discovery 10s; GUID_TIMEOUT, ATC_ACCEL_MAX, ATC_DECEL_MAX, FS_GCS_ENABLE, FS_ACTION, FS_CRASH_CHECK, FS_TIMEOUT, FS_THR_ENABLE, FS_THR_VALUE, FS_EKF_ACTION, FS_EKF_THRESH, FS_OPTIONS, FS_GCS_TIMEOUT; identity fields MAV_SYSID and DDS_USE_NS

open one PASSIVE worker with watchdog 5s; one probe and exactly 100 observations, each call timeout 2s; record host/worker timings, telemetry ages, states, cadence-related observations and RTF evidence
close the PASSIVE worker and record closure status
after worker closure, collect independent rover metrics for 20s, including status and odometry rates and RTF
confirm disarmed and stationary by passive readings
one protected STOP for rover_only after confirmed START, including on later read-only phase failure
prohibitions: container/process kill or restart outside protected lifecycle
stop_conditions: precheck not SATISFIED or fresh evidence expires before lifecycle start
START returns UNCONFIRMED: stop and preserve lease; no retry/STOP/cleanup
identity, boot, lifecycle, environment execution, readiness, or MotionBinding mismatch
worker identity/protocol mismatch or uncertain worker closure
any observed armed state, missing disarmed confirmation, or nonstationary state
read/metrics incomplete, stale, failed, unexpected dropped timing, or incompatible operation
STOP blocked or unconfirmed: preserve state and do not force cleanup
authorization_boundary: This fingerprint is for human review only; it is not a protected scope token, admission record, precheck, or authorization. The lifecycle UUID is generated at runtime by the single authorized START and must be bound to returned evidence.
known_measurement_limit: parameter reader does not verify RPC server GID; values are diagnostic and do not authorize motion; IPC_RESERVE_S=0.25 remains an assumption to compare with measured overhead
